versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Version 2.0.0 – Major update with improved CLI and feature set.

- Added metadata extraction and structured page/paragraph output.
- Introduced new commands for listing pages, extracting metadata, and running self-tests.
- Enhanced CLI options including output formatting (txt, md, json) and JSON output.
- Improved batch processing and encoding detection.
- CI integration scripts added for automated testing.
- Updated documentation; legacy file (skill-card.md) removed.

Initial release of Document Text Extractor.

- Extracts readable text from DOCX, PDF (with optional pymupdf), and plain-text files using Python standard library
- CLI tool with commands for single file and batch processing, output options, and format listing
- Zero dependencies for DOCX and TXT extraction; optional pip install for PDF support
- Supports batch extraction, encoding detection, progress reporting, and error resilience
- No cloud dependencies—entirely local processing for privacy and zero subscription costs
